topic: Demonstration of crimping techniques adopted on aircraft cables.
syllabus_extract: Demonstration of crimping techniques adopted on aircraft cables. Safety precautions to be observed while carrying out crimping on aircraft cables.
specific_objectives: 24.13.1.1 Trainee will be able to carry out workshop maintenance on aircraft cables and PCBs.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of crimping techniques on aircraft cables; Safety precautions during crimping; Instructor supervision of trainee handling.
intro_questions: What are the primary functions of aircraft cables?
List three common types of crimping tools used in aviation.
Why is proper insulation restoration critical after crimping?

development.content:
Types of crimping tools
Selection of correct crimp dies
Preparation of cable ends

Crimping technique execution
Insulation restoration methods
Verification of crimp quality

Safety precautions during crimping
Handling of sharp tools
Storage of crimped components

summary_questions: Explain the consequence of using incorrect crimp dies on cable integrity.
Describe the steps required to restore insulation after crimping.
Identify two safety hazards associated with crimping tools.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the differences between crimping techniques for PCBs versus aircraft cables, referencing the procedures covered in LP 16.
